title: एकनवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Caught like a thief, Drupada is terrified, and consults his queen, who admits the truth but urges him to protect the city. Hiranyavarman marches with his army against Panchala.
summary.kn: ಕಳ್ಳನಂತೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿದ್ದ ದ್ರುಪದನು ಭಯಗೊಂಡು ರಾಣಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅವಳು ಸತ್ಯ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಂಡು ನಗರ ಕಾಪಾಡೆಂದು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಹಿರಣ್ಯವರ್ಮನು ಸೈನ್ಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪಾಂಚಾಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: चोर की तरह पकड़े गए द्रुपद भयभीत होकर रानी से परामर्श करते हैं, जो सत्य स्वीकार कर नगर की रक्षा का आग्रह करती हैं। हिरण्यवर्मा सेना लेकर पाञ्चाल पर चढ़ाई करते हैं।
summary.te: దొంగలా పట్టుబడిన ద్రుపదుడు భయపడి రాణితో సంప్రదిస్తాడు; ఆమె సత్యాన్ని ఒప్పుకొని నగరాన్ని కాపాడమని కోరుతుంది. హిరణ్యవర్మ సైన్యంతో పాంచాలంపై దండెత్తుతాడు.
summary.ta: திருடன் போல் பிடிபட்ட த்ருபதன் அஞ்சி அரசியுடன் ஆலோசிக்க, அவள் உண்மையை ஒப்புக்கொண்டு நகரைக் காக்குமாறு வற்புறுத்துகிறாள். ஹிரண்யவர்மா படையுடன் பாஞ்சாலத்தின் மீது படையெடுக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: കള്ളനെപ്പോലെ പിടിക്കപ്പെട്ട ദ്രുപദൻ ഭയചകിതനാകുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹം രാജ്ഞിയോട് ആലോചിക്കുന്നു; അവൾ സത്യം സമ്മതിക്കുന്നു, പക്ഷേ നഗരം സംരക്ഷിക്കാൻ അവൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. ഹിരണ്യവർമ്മാവ് സൈന്യവുമായി പാഞ്ചാലത്തിനെതിരെ മാർച്ച് ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.191; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्य दूतेन द्रुपदस्य तदा नृप ।
चोरस्येव गृहीतस्य न प्रावर्तत भारती ॥

meaning.en: Addressed thus by the messenger, Drupada, O king, was like a thief caught in the act, and no word came from him.

verses.text:
स यत्नमकरोत्तीव्रं संबन्धैरनुसान्त्वनैः ।
दूतैर्मधुरसंभाषैर्नैतदस्तीति संदिशन् ॥

meaning.en: He made a strenuous effort with conciliation through kinsmen and with messengers of sweet speech, sending word that "This is not so."

verses.text:
स राजा भूय एवाथ कृत्वा तत्त्वत आगमम् ।
कन्येति पाञ्चालसुतां त्वरमाणोऽभिनिर्ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Then the king once more, having learned the true account that the Panchala child was a girl, hastily set out.

verses.text:
ततः संप्रेषयामास मित्राणाममितौजसाम् ।
दुहितुर्विप्रलम्भं तं धात्रीणां वचनात्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then, on the nurses' word, Hiranyavarman sent word of the deception about his daughter to his friends of boundless strength.

verses.text:
ततः समुदयं कृत्वा बलानां राजसत्तमः ।
अभियाने मतिं चक्रे द्रुपदं प्रति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then that best of kings gathered his forces and made up his mind to march against Drupada, O Bharata.

verses.text:
ततः संमन्त्रयामास मित्रैः सह महीपतिः ।
हिरण्यवर्मा राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यं पार्थिवं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, Hiranyavarman took counsel with his friends about the Panchala king.

verses.text:
तत्र वै निश्चितं तेषामभूद्राज्ञां महात्मनाम् ।
तथ्यं चेद्भवति ह्येतत्कन्या राजञ्शिखण्डिनी ।
बद्ध्वा पाञ्चालराजानमानयिष्यामहे गृहान् ॥

meaning.en: Those great kings decided: "If it is true that Shikhandini is a girl, we will bind the Panchala king and bring him to our homes."

verses.text:
अन्यं राजानमाधाय पाञ्चालेषु नरेश्वरम् ।
घातयिष्याम नृपतिं द्रुपदं सशिखण्डिनम् ॥

meaning.en: "We will set another man as king among the Panchalas, and have King Drupada killed along with Shikhandin."

verses.text:
स तदा दूतमाज्ञाय पुनः क्षत्तारमीश्वरः ।
प्रास्थापयत्पार्षताय हन्मीति त्वां स्थिरो भव ॥

meaning.en: The lord, having learned his messenger's report, sent his minister again to the Prishata king with the message: "I will kill you; be steady."

verses.text:
स प्रकृत्या च वै भीरुः किल्बिषी च नराधिपः ।
भयं तीव्रमनुप्राप्तो द्रुपदः पृथिवीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: King Drupada was timid by nature and had a guilty conscience, and he fell into great fear.

verses.text:
विसृज्य दूतं दाशार्णं द्रुपदः शोककर्शितः ।
समेत्य भार्यां रहिते वाक्यमाह नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: Sending the Dasharna envoy away, Drupada, wasted by grief, went to his wife alone and spoke to her.

verses.text:
भयेन महताविष्टो हृदि शोकेन चाहतः ।
पाञ्चालराजो दयितां मातरं वै शिखण्डिनः ॥

meaning.en: Seized with great fear and struck by grief in his heart, the Panchala king spoke to his beloved wife, the mother of Shikhandin.

verses.text:
अभियास्यति मां कोपात्संबन्धी सुमहाबलः ।
हिरण्यवर्मा नृपतिः कर्षमाणो वरूथिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: "My mighty kinsman, King Hiranyavarman, will march against me in anger, leading his army."

verses.text:
किमिदानीं करिष्यामि मूढः कन्यामिमां प्रति ।
शिखण्डी किल पुत्रस्ते कन्येति परिशङ्कितः ॥

meaning.en: "What am I to do now, fool that I am, about this girl? He suspects that your son Shikhandin is a girl."

verses.text:
इति निश्चित्य तत्त्वेन समित्रः सबलानुगः ।
वञ्चितोऽस्मीति मन्वानो मां किलोद्धर्तुमिच्छति ॥

meaning.en: "Having so concluded, he, with his friends, army and followers, believes he has been cheated and wishes to uproot me."

verses.text:
किमत्र तथ्यं सुश्रोणि किं मिथ्या ब्रूहि शोभने ।
श्रुत्वा त्वत्तः शुभे वाक्यं संविधास्याम्यहं तथा ॥

meaning.en: "What is true here, fair lady, and what is false? Tell me, lovely one. Having heard the truth from you, I will act accordingly."

verses.text:
अहं हि संशयं प्राप्तो बाला चेयं शिखण्डिनी ।
त्वं च राज्ञि महत्कृच्छ्रं संप्राप्ता वरवर्णिनि ॥

meaning.en: "For I am in doubt: this Shikhandini is a young girl, and you too, queen, have fallen into great trouble, fair one."

verses.text:
सा त्वं सर्वविमोक्षाय तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः ।
तथा विदध्यां सुश्रोणि कृत्यस्यास्य शुचिस्मिते ।
शिखण्डिनि च मा भैस्त्वं विधास्ये तत्र तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "So for deliverance from it all, tell me the truth when I ask. Then, fair-hipped, bright-smiling queen, I will act in this matter; and do not fear for Shikhandini, I will act properly there."

verses.text:
क्रिययाहं वरारोहे वञ्चितः पुत्रधर्मतः ।
मया दाशार्णको राजा वञ्चितश्च महीपतिः ।
तदाचक्ष्व महाभागे विधास्ये तत्र यद्धितम् ॥

meaning.en: "By a trick, lovely one, I deceived the king of the Dasharnas, treating her as a son; tell me, fortunate one, and I will do what is best."

verses.text:
जानतापि नरेन्द्रेण ख्यापनार्थं परस्य वै ।
प्रकाशं चोदिता देवी प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Although the king knew it, so that it might be declared to another, he urged the queen openly, and she answered the king.
